sources.title: Feriados Nacionales 2026 (official holidays dataset)
sources.supports: official 2026 national holiday calendar, read directly on 19 November 2026; the only territorial special holidays in that dataset are the 10 and 11 November 2026 papal-visit days for Cordoba, the City of Buenos Aires and Buenos Aires Province

culture-cycles.note: The official 2026 national holidays dataset of the Ministry of the Interior lists no additional provincial holiday for Formosa Province. National public holidays are on Argentina's record. Recurring provincial patron or foundation days are not in that dataset, so this record does not claim a complete provincial calendar. The 2027 official dataset had not been published when this was checked.
